versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
A touring snake theatre troupe whose actors play dead instead of dying, so each death triggers its scene and the cast rises again in a curtain call.
Deaths pay for permanent stats, gold or a second board, and seating decides who goes down when.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules fixes: risen units keep any Play Dead lives left, a Death Scene can never trigger itself, and Berus says what extra triggers hit.
Little Anguis now just drops a Tail carrying a fallen neighbour's scene; Saucers can rehearse a scene and the Natterjack pays per unit down, not for near-losses.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
